name: @dharmax/codebase-parser
description: Universal, lightweight, and fast multi-language codebase parser for symbols, facts, and notes.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --sourcemap --external:node:path && tsc src/index.mjs --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --allowJs

author: dharmax
